  "overall_experience": "This Assistant Manager found Basecamp to be a straightforward and reliable tool for organizing and managing tasks within their large retail company. They appreciated its simplicity and clear structure, which made it easy to get team members up to speed. However, they occasionally felt limited by its functionality and noted some minor frustrations with notification timing and the mobile interface."
